resources.string: Waiting for Magisk approval on this Pixel…
Install or enable Google Photos on this Pixel.
Magisk access is unavailable. You can reconnect the meter.
This phone’s kernel does not expose the supported Wi-Fi counter.
The meter timed out. Unlock the Pixel and try again.
Magisk grants superuser access for the live meter. Pixel Backup uses it to read the number of Wi-Fi bytes sent by Google Photos. Sampling stops when you leave the dashboard.
Android grants access to notifications from all apps. Pixel Backup reads only recognized Google Photos backup updates. Counts stay on this phone.
Connect Photos status, or enter the count you see in Google Photos.
Waiting for a backup notification from Google Photos. You can also enter a count.
Android is connecting Photos status. You can also enter a count.
Last reported by Google Photos %1$s ago. Open Photos for its current count.
Google Photos has no recent status update. You can check Photos and enter its current count.
Google Photos is backing up. An estimate needs a few changes in its remaining count.
Based on recent changes in the Google Photos queue. Videos can take longer.
Google Photos reports a backup in progress. Open Photos to check how many items remain.
Google Photos reports a pause. Open Photos for details.
Google Photos reports that its backup queue is complete.
Enter a lower count after 30 seconds for an estimate.
Enter the current Photos count to refresh it.
Open Google Photos to confirm backup.
Enter the items remaining in Google Photos. Use counts from the same backup. Clear your entries when you start another.
Enter a whole number from 0 to 2,147,483,647.
Open Settings and search for Notification access.
